public_rationale: The reviewed disclosures do not establish the claimed customer shares or compute allocations. Amazon's AI run rate and Alphabet's broader cloud segment measure different things from the asserted realized AI revenue share. The approximate Microsoft estimate found in reporting does not settle a greater-than-70% threshold for all three providers. public_payload.normalized_proposition: The author believes Google, Amazon and Microsoft, but notably not Meta, have seen remarkable revenue growth in the AI era because they sell effectively all their available compute to Anthropic or OpenAI, which make up more than 70% of their AI revenues. He believes this is also why the only AI data center companies with any revenue growth, such as CoreWeave, Nebius and IREN, are connected directly or by proxy to those two labs.

statement.excerpt: I believe the reason that Google, Amazon, Microsoft, and most notably not Meta have seen remarkable revenue growth in the AI era is that they’re selling effectively all of their available compute to either Anthropic or OpenAI, who make up more than 70% of their AI revenues

from_speaker: remarkable revenue growth in the AI era
selling effectively all of their available compute
more than 70% of their AI revenues
the only AI data center companies with any revenue growth
connected directly or by proxy to the two AI labs
our_interpretation: Read the statement as asserting that OpenAI and Anthropic together exceed 70% of each named provider's AI revenue, rather than only their combined revenue.
Read available compute as commercially available AI compute, given the surrounding discussion of GPUs.

Use April–June 2026, the latest completed reporting quarter before publication, for the ongoing revenue-share and allocation assertions. The surrounding Microsoft fiscal-year example is a different measurement period.
Read the causal assertion as saying that purchases by the two labs materially explain the providers' revenue growth.
Read the Meta exception as excluding Meta from this compute-sales mechanism, not necessarily denying that Meta's revenue grew.
The phrase I believe qualifies confidence but leaves concrete factual assertions to test.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable customer-level records show that the two labs account for more than 70% of each named provider's realized AI revenue and nearly all available AI compute, and that their purchases materially explain growth. Records also establish the asserted lab connections across growing AI data center providers.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records show a combined lab share at or below 70% for a named provider, substantial available AI compute serving other customers, or a growing AI data center provider without the asserted direct or indirect connection. Evidence of other growth drivers must quantify their importance to contradict the causal component.
